description: This file contains Perl code that generates optimized assembly routines for SHA-512 hashing on x86_64 architecture, including multiple SIMD-accelerated paths (SSSE3, AVX, AVX2, AVX-512) and support for Intel SHA extensions. It defines functions for processing SHA-512 blocks with architecture-specific optimizations, and includes code for exception handling on Windows. The code dynamically generates assembly code for different CPU features and hash variants, with detailed comments on performance and architecture considerations.
